name: Clamshell
steps: Lie on your side with your head resting on your bottom arm, stacking your hips and shoulders in a straight vertical line.
Bend your knees to a 90-degree angle and bend your hips to approximately 45 degrees, with your feet stacked together.
Keeping your heels glued together, slowly rotate your top knee upward toward the ceiling as high as comfortable without rolling your pelvis backward.
Pause at the top for one full second, feeling your outer glute contract.
Slowly lower your top knee back down until it touches your bottom knee.
coaching_cues: Place your top hand on your hip bone to verify your pelvis stays still and does not rock backward.
Only raise the knee as high as you can maintain pure hip rotation.
Keep your feet touching throughout the entire set.
